# Python dependencies for the committed automation in .github/scripts/.
#
#   pip install -r .github/scripts/requirements.txt
#
# Only the scripts named below need it. Everything else is standard
# library only: run_checks.py and its --fast subset, the audit, the
# stylesheet build, the unit tests, and the weekly refresh_now.py,
# refresh_books.py and validate_data.py. Of the --check modes, only
# detect_monochrome.py's needs a package (Pillow), which is why
# site-checks.yml installs this file in the smoke job alone.

# smoke_test.py - headless render checks, also installed by site-checks.yml.
# The browser itself is a separate download:  playwright install chromium
# Pinned exactly, not >=: each Playwright release drives one Chromium
# build, and CI caches that browser under this version, so the pin is
# what makes the cache key mean something. Bump it deliberately, with
# a local smoke run.
playwright==1.59.0

# subset_icon_fonts.py - subsets the icon fonts to the glyphs actually used.
# fontTools writes the .woff2 flavour through brotli, so it is a hard
# requirement here, not an optional speed-up.
fonttools>=4.62
brotli>=1.2

# generate_og_images.py - renders each post's share card with Pillow, and
# reads the site's woff2 fonts through fontTools (above).
# detect_monochrome.py - reads thumbnail pixels to decide the gallery's
# B&W tag. generate_photo_dims.py reads WebP headers itself and only
# falls back to Pillow for an unfamiliar container.
Pillow>=10
